info.title: ArchLinterNet.Cli
info.description: .NET tool for running ArchLinterNet architecture contracts from YAML policies. Supports strict and audit modes with human and JSON output.

commands.name: badge
commands.description: Generate architecture validation badge payloads.

commands.name: architecture-policy
commands.description: Write Shields endpoint JSON from strict validation JSON.

commands.name: architecture-health
commands.description: Write Shields endpoint JSON from canonical Architecture Health JSON.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Preview or generate a versioned consumer badge setup.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose a versioned badge setup without writing.

commands.name: apply-handoff
commands.description: Verify and apply a trusted bootstrap handoff to a normal review branch.

commands.name: lifecycle
commands.description: Inspect or mutate an authenticated badge Relay registration.

commands.name: change
commands.description: Create and compare complete architecture analysis snapshots.

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Write a complete architecture change snapshot.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Compare two complete architecture change snapshots.

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Render architecture coverage reports.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Render Markdown from strict validation JSON.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract one mode from combined validation JSON.

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Fail CI on new architecture debt and error-severity policy weakening.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Project the canonical architecture-health/v1 summary.

commands.name: revalidate-publication
commands.description: Refresh temporal publication evidence from a serialized Health artifact.

options.name: --source-health-sha256
options.description: SHA-256 of exact Health input bytes

options.name: --badge-payload-sha256
options.description: SHA-256 of exact badge payload bytes

commands.name: history
commands.description: Analyze release architecture forensics evidence over an explicit Git range.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Generate a versioned release architecture forensics report over an explicit Git range.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Render architecture governance reports from canonical artifacts.

commands.name: pr
commands.description: Render a deterministic architecture pull-request report.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: List or print release-matched packaged schemas without network access.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List logical ids, versions, immutable ids, and packaged paths.

commands.name: print
commands.description: Print one exact packaged schema to standard output.

commands.name: topology
commands.description: Capture, diff, and verify declared architecture topology.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture canonical topology observations for review.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Project declared topology evidence for review.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify declared topology using ordinary validation.
